title: Forecasting water quality parameters using artificial neural network for irrigation purposes.
summary: Field measurements show season- and site-specific Ele River irrigation-quality exceedances, and the ANN forecasts those parameters with reported test/forecast performance.
ai_technology: Methods §§ FFMLP/training: feed-forward multilayer perceptron with supervised back-propagation forecasts pH, TDS, EC and sodium for 1–12 months.
organization: Department of Agricultural and Bioresources Engineering

evidence.tested: Ele River samples at four sites show TDS/EC/Na exceed FAO limits at points 1–3 (and across dry season); concentrations decline downstream.
evidence.unknown: Observed water-quality tests provide the substantive reference; ANN test and forecast R² ranges and RMSE are reported. Scope is local river/irrigation assessment, not water safety generally.
evidence.ai_role: Methods §§ FFMLP/training: feed-forward multilayer perceptron with supervised back-propagation forecasts pH, TDS, EC and sodium for 1–12 months.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
